svg.metadata: {"id": "s024", "name": "戏曲舞台", "cat": "语文与历史", "tags": ["语文", "戏曲", "传统文化", "音乐"], "desc": "传统戏台：飞檐屋顶、红柱金饰，正中绣有祥云的守旧幕，两侧脸谱、灯笼与堂鼓，追光照亮舞台中央。", "stand": {"ground_y": 880, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "bg", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "backdrop", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "frame", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "curtains", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "stage", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "spot", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "masks", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "table_chairs", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "drum", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lanterns", "enter": "drop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "lantern_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}], "palette": {"bg1": "#5A2E3C", "bg2": "#3E2230", "red": "#C8443F", "red2": "#A3333A", "gold": "#E8B858", "gold2": "#C9913C", "back": "#B23A3C", "back2": "#962F35", "cloud": "#F0C36A", "roof": "#3C4150", "roof2": "#545B6E", "beam": "#2F6E78", "beam2": "#4F9AA0", "floor1": "#B8743F", "floor2": "#95592E", "carpet": "#D2524A", "carpet2": "#B8403C", "wood": "#8E4F2E", "mask1": "#FFFFFF", "mask2": "#D8433C", "mask3": "#2B2B33", "blue": "#3F7FB5", "light": "#FFE9B0"}}
